crossRefs.note: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.
In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be…
‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his…
When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a…
Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will…
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…
I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail…
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with…
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…
He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil…
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will…
Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against…
Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions…
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

translations.web: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
translations.bsb: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”
translations.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
translations.asv: but if it is of God, ye will not be able to overthrow them; lest haply ye be found even to be fighting against God.
